event: The Ascent Gate from Floor 17 sets the party down in a narrow wet-stone corridor.
Solenne hears water running under the floor.
Terrain Read shows deep channels running parallel to the main path.
Tomás names Floor 18 and says the channels run its length, branching every forty meters.
Dayo asks him to say the channels are too narrow for anything that matters; he can't.
Miriam briefly touches the Warden's Grove Focus.
Solenne notes anything could come out of the channels at any point.
Tomás says they can't keep full perimeter coverage.
Dayo says move fast and tight with Miriam in center; Miriam objects, Dayo insists.
Miriam lets it go, and the party moves.
Nadia has said nothing since the Gate; she operates precisely but at a different angle.
Solenne notices and makes the next call instead of noting it.
Solenne orders standard interval and asks Tomás to listen to the channels.
Tomás says he is already running it.
At forty meters a Deepscale Lurker bursts from the left channel toward Miriam.
Dayo Shield Rushes between the Lurker and Miriam, taking the hit on her shoulder.
Vesper opens a vial.
Nadia silently sets a trap in the channel mouth.
A second Lurker hits the trap at full speed thirty seconds later.
Nadia places a second trap in the right-hand channel.
Solenne notes Nadia read the channel timing from the first emergence.
Dayo downs the first Lurker in forty seconds; Miriam heals her with Mending Touch.
The System awards 180 XP and two Deepscale Hides.
Tomás predicts two more channels before the node, emergence biased left.
Nadia asks when he started hearing the sound; he says thirty seconds in.
Nadia says she heard it at entry; Tomás makes a notation.
At the ninety-meter mark two Lurkers emerge from the left channel.
One Lurker gets past Dayo's left side, heading for Miriam.
Miriam casts full Mending Touch on Dayo to draw the second Lurker's aggro onto herself.
Dayo catches the second Lurker with a full Shield Rush.
Both Lurkers go down in two minutes flat.
Through the Conductor, Solenne reads Miriam's Warmhearted signal a degree dimmer.
Solenne quietly reduces Miriam's coverage corner by fifteen degrees.
Solenne writes 'ceiling' in the margin of the floor notes and closes the notebook.
The System awards 340 XP, loot, and a Non-System Item, Not Catalogued.
The loot display points to a natural alcove where the channels end.
Nadia stands at the alcove's edge and says someone left this here.
A human-made waterproof case sits in the alcove.
Solenne opens the case and finds an old eight-string travel dulcimer, intact.
Vesper says someone carried this to Floor 18 and left it.
Tomás, without touching it, says it works.
Nadia looks at the dulcimer with an unguarded face.
Dayo asks if she knows how to play; Nadia says she used to and stopped.
Vesper hands the dulcimer to Nadia, who takes it.
The party sets up camp in a wide, drier rest node at the floor's end.
Dayo does gear maintenance, Tomás notes, Vesper inscribes, Miriam opens her notebook.
Solenne writes the encounter notes and closes them.
Nadia sits with the dulcimer across her lap.
Nadia tightens and tunes the two slack strings; Vesper glances up.
Nadia plays a first tentative note.
Solenne's Harmony Conductor senses pressure at the edge of her perception.
Solenne's RES rises from 19 to 20 and party Resonance Events reach 102/150.
Solenne hears all six Aspects at once in a four-second Full Chord Event.
In the chord, Nadia's Brightspirit carries something much older underneath.
The Conductor settles; Nadia keeps playing, not performing.
Solenne checks her status window, Level 25, Class Proving, 102/150, and closes it.
Solenne understands the wait is for all six to be ready at once, and won't force it.
Dayo's hands stop on her gear; she sets the armor piece down.
Miriam's notebook is open but she is not writing.
Vesper stops mid-motion in the Workframe, looking at the wall.
Tomás stops writing and looks at the middle distance.
Nadia plays on; the stone and water under the floor carry the sound.
Solenne watches Miriam close her notebook and Tomás set down his pen.
Tomás takes Vasic's coordinates paper from his pack and sets it beside Solenne.
Tomás returns to his spot without a word and picks up his pen.
Solenne reads his three ranked cross-references on the second script in the margin.
She refolds the paper and puts it back in her utility belt's inner pocket.
Solenne sits with the paper, the chord, and Nadia's words, leaving them unanswered.
The rest node shows full recovery in progress at 102/150 as the music goes on.
